desc: Display and rotate the root CA
u: docker-swarm-ca - Display and rotate the root CA

--ca-cert
= Path to the PEM-formatted root CA certificate to use for the new cluster
--ca-key
= Path to the PEM-formatted root CA key to use for the new cluster
--cert-expiry
=2160h0m0s Validity period for node certificates (ns|us|ms|s|m|h)
-d, --detach
[=false] Exit immediately instead of waiting for the root rotation to converge
--external-ca
= Specifications of one or more certificate signing endpoints
-q, --quiet
[=false] Suppress progress output
--rotate
[=false] Rotate the swarm CA - if no certificate or key are provided, new ones will be generated
